rule: implementation_use = ALLOWED (the only state that sets implementation_allowed = true in AIRCRAFT_NUMERIC_FIELD_INDEX.json) requires: the source's own content inspected by the library at PAGE_VERIFIED, the configuration known, units and convention known, and the page/table/figure recorded. Values read only in other Maverick documents carry exactness REPOSITORY_READING and verification_level SEARCH_LEAD_ONLY: the repository reading is recorded in existing_maverick_analysis, it is not a primary source.

configurations.label: NASA Langley TP-1538 simulation configuration (development-era F-16 with relaxed static stability)
configurations.engine: Afterburning turbofan; engine model named in App. B not identified by variant in repository reading

configurations.notes: Maverick's current 'NASA Reference F-16'. Not a production block. Mass/geometry/thrust in this configuration are the TP-1538 simulation's own.

configurations.label: Morelli (1998) global polynomial fit to the TP-1538-lineage subsonic F-16 database

configurations.notes: LEF fixed at 25 deg by construction (repository analysis); M < 0.6; alpha -10..45; beta +/-30.
